==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Active Ability: Time Erase==
[[File:TimeEraseIcon.png|thumb|left]] 
When Devil Boss uses his ability "Time Erase", he gives every unit on the map a 50% damage boost while heavily slowing units down (duration is 8-9 seconds).




==Trivia==
*{{PAGENAME}} is one of the first units that increases the vulnerability of enemies along with [[Blackhair]], followed up by [[Shadow Sorcerer]] and [[Cursed King]]
*{{PAGENAME}} Time Erase causes all enemies to move so slowly that they're basically frozen, which is why people usually call his ability a "TS" instead of slow.
